usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is completely empty — no claims or citations are provided, so there is nothing to assess for overclaims or to support meeting preparation. The only substantive content is identity anchors and a list of flagged unjustified conclusions (stale Kohl's CEO role, sole Frappuccino credit, chemical engineer claim), which indicate known failure modes but no dossier text to attribute them to. A reader learns almost nothing about who Michelle Gass is or what she did beyond a one-line identity summary, and cannot prepare for a conversation. The dossier also never states what it does not know. No overclaim findings are possible since there are no dossier statements with citation indices to excerpt.
